Definition: from G659; a repository, i.e. granary:--barn, garner.
BiblicalUsage: A barn or storehouse is where the harvest is kept, and Jesus uses it both ways. The birds do not sow or gather into barns, yet the Father feeds them; the wheat is gathered into the barn while the tares are burned; the rich fool plans bigger barns for a life he will not live; and John says the wheat will be gathered into the garner.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the barn tests what we trust. Hoarding for a future we do not control is folly, and trusting the Father who feeds the birds is not carelessness, it is faith.
